Karon at a glance

Our catalogue currently lists 5 development projects in Karon: 1 villa, 4 condominiums. Advertised starting prices run from ฿3,700,000 to ฿19,900,000 (5 of 5 projects publish a price; the rest are on request). Ownership offered by the developers: freehold, so please confirm the exact title with your lawyer before buying.

About Karon

Karon is a west-coast beach area in Mueang Phuket district, between Patong to the north and Kata to the south. The condominiums we list here are Vibe Residence Karon, The Kuartz, Ever Prime Residences and Ashiyana Heights, together with one pool-villa project, Mali Thai Kata; most are pre-sale or under construction, with completion dates advertised from 2028.

Ashiyana Heights and Mali Thai Kata are described as lying between Karon and Kata, and the project data gives about 1.1-1.4 km to Kata Beach for them; Vibe Residence Karon is listed about 1 km from Karon Beach (its developer advertises 180 m, so confirm on site). Distances are still missing for some projects, so ask us for travel times to the beach, shops and the airport.

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Patong · Kata
